name: Design
ai_usage: Claude Code surveyed the developer machine (tool versions, TLS proxy diagnosis, SQLite feature probe), wrote the tools recommendation, then produced the architecture, data model and UX design documents. It loaded the Claude API reference to use current model IDs, pricing, structured-output and caching rules rather than memory. All 10 PRD open questions were closed with numbered architecture decisions.
